title: A bug report whose fix may already be present
task:
# Task

A handoff says: "The port parser accepts zero. Add a lower-bound check." Inspect the current implementation and determine whether a fix is needed. You can run the supplied tests with `node --test test/port.test.cjs`.
responseInstructions:
Return decision.json with decision ("no-change" or "fix-required"), facts ({"acceptsZero": boolean}), and citations.

Write only decision.json. Keep all supplied files unchanged. This is a read-only triage exercise, not an implementation task. Include citations as an array of {"path":"relative/file","quote":"exact source excerpt"}. Quote the relevant source text. Do not claim to have run a command unless you ran it.
